verdict.rationale: Where auth and user data run is a fair question for an auth product, but the evidence shows no self-managed deployment, private or dedicated instance, or bring-your-own-database option for Clerk. The "deploy to your own domain" claim is about custom domains, an adjacent feature that does not control where the system or its data lives. Community comments contrast Clerk with alternatives that keep auth data in your own DB, which points to a hosted-only model.
